task_objective: Extract shared release-selection logic into plugin_release_utils.py, fix testing-channel semver selection, and resolve review round 01 notes.
design_decisions: Extracted normalize_version, parse_semver, version_sort_key, has_exactly_one_zip, get_zip_asset, and select_best_release into plugin_release_utils.py.
Fixed select_best_release to rank purely by version_sort_key so higher semver prereleases (e.g. 2.0.0-beta.1) take precedence over lower stable releases (e.g. 1.0.0) when allow_prerelease=True.
Updated generate_json.py to import and delegate to plugin_release_utils while explicitly re-exporting parse_semver for external callers.
Replaced assert zip_asset is not None in generate_json.py with explicit if zip_asset is None: return None to prevent issues with python -O.

Catalog diff verification findings: releases with uppercase Plugin.ZIP are newly eligible (case-insensitive zip matching); releases with both plugin.zip and Plugin.ZIP are skipped as ambiguous (2 zip assets match case-insensitively). Dual-casing skip decision pinned with tests.
Mutation test verification: reverting select_best_release to fork logic resulted in AssertionError ('v1.0.0' == 'v2.0.0-beta.1') in test_select_best_release_testing_prefers_higher_prerelease.
